technical_and_design_decisions: For U1, use JMH for microbenchmarks and document infrastructure specs (JVM, OS, hardware).
For U2, modify module lifecycle to defer context bootstrapping until job launch and trigger shutdown on completion.
For U3, implement tap output for Spark streaming module and update documentation with Reliable receiver details.
For U4, integrate Spring Boot Actuator's MetricRepositoryAutoConfiguration to expose custom metrics via /actuator/metrics.
For U5, refactor module options to use Spring Boot's property source management and leverage configuration metadata.
For U6, design a centralized external configuration service using Spring Cloud Config with server and client support for XD-Admin and XD-Container.
For U7, profile RabbitMQ message bus with tools like JProfiler or VisualVM to identify bottlenecks and apply fixes.
For U8, set up reproducible CI builds on EC2 using existing build scripts and Jenkins/GitHub Actions.
assumptions: Developer works full-time and is experienced with Spring Framework, Boot, and XD codebase.
All stories are independent and can be developed sequentially or in parallel as needed.
Testing (unit, integration, performance) is included in each activity's effort.
Documentation updates are part of the development effort for U1, U3, U6.
No external dependencies or third-party library approvals needed beyond standard Spring ecosystem.
Existing CI infrastructure can be migrated to EC2 with minimal downtime.
Effort estimates are in workdays (1 day = 8 hours).

activities.activity_description: Create JMH benchmarks for key Spring XD components, document infrastructure specifics, and publish results.
Modify job module to bootstrap context only when job is launched and shutdown upon completion, improving resource utilization.
Add tap output to Spark streaming module, update examples, and enhance documentation on Reliable receiver.
Integrate Spring Boot Actuator to expose module/app specific metrics using MetricRepositoryAutoConfiguration.

activities.activity_name: Module options via Boot property source management
activities.activity_description: Refactor module options to use Spring Boot property source management and leverage configuration metadata for injection.
Implement a centralized external configuration system with server and client support for XD-Admin and XD-Container across environments.
Diagnose performance bottlenecks in RabbitMQ message bus, isolate root cause, and apply fixes.
Set up and migrate existing CI build jobs from current infrastructure to EC2 instances for centralized management and reliability.
